titre: Le passé : did et les verbes irréguliers
objectif: Poser des questions sur le passé et utiliser les verbes irréguliers courants

dialogue.contexte: Emma revient d'un salon professionnel à Paris.
lignes: Lucas
Did you go to the trade fair in Paris?
Tu es allée au salon à Paris ?
Emma
Yes, I went on Thursday. I met a lot of brands.
Oui, j'y suis allée jeudi. J'ai rencontré beaucoup de marques.
Lucas
Did you find new clients?
Tu as trouvé de nouveaux clients ?
Emma
I didn't sign any contracts, but I gave out fifty business cards!
Je n'ai signé aucun contrat, mais j'ai distribué cinquante cartes de visite !
Lucas
What did you think of the stands?
Qu'est-ce que tu as pensé des stands ?
Emma
They were beautiful. I took a lot of photos.
Ils étaient magnifiques. J'ai pris plein de photos.
Emma
And I bought some French cheese for the team!
Et j'ai acheté du fromage français pour l'équipe !

fiche:
Question et négation : did

Did you go? · I didn't sign. · What did you think?

Après did / didn't, le verbe revient à sa forme de base : Did you go? (jamais « did you went »).

Les irréguliers, par familles

ne changent pasput, cut, let, cost, hit
-ought / -aughtbuy → bought, bring → brought, think → thought, teach → taught
-ewknow → knew, grow → grew, fly → flew, throw → threw
-ent / -ld / -idsend → sent, spend → spent, sell → sold, tell → told, pay → paid, say → said
voyelle qui changemeet → met, get → got, take → took, write → wrote, speak → spoke, win → won
à partgo → went, see → saw, make → made, give → gave, find → found, come → came
💡 Apprends-les par familles de sons plutôt que dans l'ordre alphabétique : ton cerveau retient mieux ce qui se ressemble.

exercices.consigne: Associe chaque verbe à son prétérit

exercices.sous: Elle a acheté un nouvel ordinateur.

exercices.texte: Did you went to the meeting?

exercices.consigne: Mets la phrase à la forme négative

exercices.texte: What did you think of the presentation?
I took a lot of photos.

production.consigne: Raconte une expérience (stage, voyage, projet) en 3 phrases avec des verbes irréguliers.
production.modele: Last year, I went to London. I met a lot of people and I spoke English every day. I bought too many books!
verifs: J'ai utilisé au moins 2 verbes irréguliers
Après did / didn't, j'ai mis la forme de base
